# Core tests that fail on GitHub's hosted runners for timing reasons only.
#
# The hosted "Linux · core" shards leave these out; the advisory job "Linux ·
# core (timing-sensitive)" runs them alone, one at a time, on every run that
# runs Core, and its failures do not fail "Linux · core". Local gates and
# `tools/mg core-test` still run every test. Each failure stays tracked in
# docs/process/verification-status.md ("Hosted Core timing-sensitive tests").
#
# One test per line, as nextest prints it: `<binary id> <test name>  # reason`.
# When a test is fixed, delete its line: the shards then run it again.

# Seen once, under watch (not listed; add a line only if one fails again on a
# hosted runner). Hosted run 44726666111 (pull request #6), three consecutive
# meguri-ffi tests with deadline errors:
#   collection_export::tests::captured_review_reopens_and_later_answers_do_not_change_ready_file  (acceptance durability deadline exceeded)
#   collection_entry::tests::public_initial_all_media_import_close_reopen_and_public_export_preserves_r6_evidence  (SuspendDeadline at "resource cutoff")
#   collection_entry::tests::public_initial_entry_imports_all_media_and_initializes_own_journal  (no terminal event)
# Hosted run 44736094914 (CI-only change), shard 1:
#   meguri-host::host_it collection_export_safety::normal_export_discard_preserves_real_forced_backup_and_user_destination  (ExportSourceChanged after 0.04 s)
